component.subject: Eucharist
component.title: Preparation of the Table
component.author: W. E. Orchard
component.source: W. E. Orchard, The Order of Divine Service (1921), A Simple Observance of the Lord's Supper, p. 116: the President's opening words (Matthew 26:19) and the first rubric. Adapted for use without a president; scripture lightly modernised.

original.p: The disciples did as Jesus appointed them; and they made ready the Passover.
(Here the elements may be distributed, and those who are to partake may prepare themselves by prayer.)

block.p: The disciples did as Jesus directed them; and they made ready the Passover.
block.rubric: Here the bread and cup are set out and may be distributed, and those who are to partake prepare themselves by prayer
